methodology.title: How we score
methodology.intro: SmartNutri checks each packaged food against its label and each family member's profile using fixed rules. An AI only explains the result; it never decides it. This is information, not medical advice.
methodology.pending_review: These thresholds are working values, pending review by a clinician.

nutriscore_2023.title: Nutri-Score (calculated by SmartNutri)
nutriscore_2023.description: We calculate a Nutri-Score grade from the label, using the 2023 update of the method. It is calculated by SmartNutri; it is not an FSSAI rating.

high_in.title: High in sugar, fat, saturated fat or salt
high_in.description: A product is marked high in a nutrient when its amount per 100 g or 100 ml is at or above these limits.

allergens.title: Allergens
allergens.description: We look for each allergen's ingredient names and for the pack's allergen statements. If the ingredients can't be read, we say the label is unclear, never OK.

diet.title: Diet
diet.description: We look for ingredients that don't fit a member's diet (vegetarian, eggetarian, vegan or Jain) and check the green or brown mark on the pack.

claims.title: Front-of-pack claims
claims.description: We check claims such as "sugar free" or "high protein" against the label values and the FSSAI limits.

blood_sugar.title: Blood sugar
blood_sugar.description: For members managing blood sugar (diabetes, prediabetes or PCOS), we flag products with a lot of sugar, or a lot of carbohydrate per serving, and high salt or saturated fat.

hypertension.title: Blood pressure
hypertension.description: For members with high blood pressure, we flag products with a lot of salt.

weight_loss.title: Weight loss
weight_loss.description: For members losing weight, we flag energy-dense products and low Nutri-Score grades, and note products with good protein for their calories.

child.title: Children
child.description: For children, we compare the sugar in 100 g or one serving with a daily sugar limit for their age.

infant.title: Babies and toddlers
infant.description: For babies and toddlers, we flag added sugar, added salt, honey and caffeine, and high sugar or salt.

custom_alerts.title: Your ingredient alerts
custom_alerts.description: Ingredients a member asked to be told about, such as palm oil or maida. These are preferences, so there is no source to cite.

daily_limits.title: Daily limits
daily_limits.description: In the food log, we add up the sugar and salt logged for each member in a day and compare the totals with a daily limit for their age. Protein is shown as progress towards a daily target. Labels give total sugar, not only added sugar, so this can warn more than needed.
